title: Origins Mycophile
description: The official Mycophile Origin from the Lornwood SMP
body:
# The Mycophile Origin
## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Required Mods

- [Apugli](https://modrinth.com/mod/apugli) (To be able to eat the Shrooms)
- [Eggolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/eggolib/versions) (required)
- [Extra Keybinds](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-extra-keybinds-fabric) (for the powers)


## Origin Info
Check the Gallery for a cleaner view

## Lore
Gaining sentience through a means lost to time, this origin is connected deeply to the cycle of life and death, as a fungal creature of the dark and wet world. 

## Powers

### Infecting Spore
Throw a lump of spores at your enemy from a distance

### Fragile Skin
Your body is softer and more delicate than most, resulting in a weaker constitution.

### Fungal Nurishment
You can consume smaller, weaker mushrooms than yourself for food. Overfilling yourself is an option.

### Mycelium Planting
Root yourself into the ground, spreading mushrooms.

### Photosensitive
When in direct sunlight, you are weakened.

### Rotten Tongue
Your diet is not affected by rot. Any flesh is food for you.

### Mushroom Stealth
Your Spores let you deflect light in ways to make you not visible

### Toxic Tendrils
Stab your foes with your tendrils to temporarly make them sick
